owner_authority: Owner2026-10-28: steps1/2<=150minutes; one conditional step3<=120minutes; old scientific gates immutable.

consumer.actor: research analyst reviewing a daily breakout follow-up list
consumer.action: review at most5 security/date units; retain every20/60 context assertion inside one unit
consumer.claim_ceiling: Research triage only; no investor return, live analyst time saving or historical-as-known claim.

shared_inputs: same exact context universe and UNKNOWN denominator
comparison.baseline: existing frozen R0, no deliberately weakened or information-deprived baseline

ranking_before_reference.multiple_scales: rank unit by greatest asserted stage, retain all assertions and UNKNOWN
ranking_before_reference.unknown: in denominator; no nomination by UNKNOWN alone

comparison.same_review_slots_and_input_cost: same maximum slots and identical Facts; report actual cost; same-cost benefit requires equal actual use
comparison.useful_only_if: at same cost fewer false alerts with no lost definite positives, or more definite positives with no extra false alerts; no claim if neither strictly improves
comparison.uncertainty: paired issuer-cluster summaries; dependent episodes/scales are not independent votes

opportunity_set.overlapping_episodes: one security/date unit retaining all distinct context assertions

measure_definitions.recognition: original context/episode quality gates unchanged; no pilot scoring
measure_definitions.selected_positive_units: selected security/date with at least one matched definite3/4; also report every error in that unit
measure_definitions.wrong_stage_assertions: asserted3 against definite4, or4 against definite3, at same context/scale
measure_definitions.missed_positive_units: unit has definite3/4 reference but no selected matching assertion; UNKNOWN is not negative
measure_definitions.cost: one per selected security/date; report used/unused slots and actual cost; no fillers
measure_definitions.benefit: original positive/false-alert dominance at equal actual cost; unequal use gives an inconclusive same-cost claim
measure_definitions.review_worthiness: separate reviewer judgement; never inferred solely from state correctness

sampling_preflight.source_scope: only previously admitted2021 prefixes and already authorized identity/calendar metadata

reference.old_tier_ceiling: deterministic rule shadow and reproducibility only; not human or new independent AI review
reference.purpose_requires: candidate-blind separately attributable semantic judgements on same T-only packets, independent of compared threshold rules as sole truth

semantic_rubric.stage3: A visible attempt to leave an earlier upper price region, with insufficient evidence yet for sustained acceptance. Explain the earlier region and observations supporting the attempt.
semantic_rubric.stage4: Earlier escape followed by sustained acceptance outside that earlier region through T. Explain repeated observations and counterevidence; ordinary uptrend alone is insufficient.
semantic_rubric.negative: Visible evidence clearly supports neither condition, including a failed/reversed attempt. Cite actual observations.
semantic_rubric.ambiguous: Both3 and4 interpretations remain supportable; preserve[3,4].
semantic_rubric.unjudgeable: Insufficient history/coordinate reliability, or no defensible earlier region at the requested scale. Missing evidence is not negative.
semantic_rubric.review_worthiness: Separately yes/no/unknown: does this packet warrant one human research review slot? Give reason without future outcomes.

pilot.selection: hash order: scale20/60 x visible61/shorter-history;scale20:4full+2short;scale60:6full (no short packets exist); distinct issuer and episode
pilot.blinding: opaque caseID,T-only normalized raw OHLCV and completeness; no candidate anchor,phase,holdcount,labels,tags,stratum,prediction
pilot.context_isolation: two fresh Sol6.1 Max contexts without prior transcript or compared thresholds
pilot.resolution: agreement kept at model-assisted grade; unresolved disagreements UNKNOWN unless a factual source correction resolves them; votes never create truth
pilot.method_acceptance: bound isolated inputs/calls; citations checked; semantic rationale inspected for circular rule shadow; within budget; no invented semantic agreement threshold

step3_requires: qualified exact new input and complete hashes
execution.when_unmet: record exact NO_GO and NOT_RUN, preserve reusable code and qualified facts; no automatic resampling or extra round
